name: ai2kit-monorepo
description: Ai2Kit — AI-built site to Elementor converter (monorepo)

scripts.e2e: for fmt in v3 v4; do for f in static-landing.zip lovable-spa-dist.zip ai-tailwind.html icons.html; do node tests/e2e/convert.mjs --file tests/fixtures/source/$f --format $fmt --out tests/e2e/output/$fmt-${f%%.*} --min 90 || exit 1; done; done
scripts.lint:php: cd plugin/ai2kit && composer lint && composer stan
scripts.plugin-check: node scripts/release.mjs --skip-tests && wp-env run cli wp plugin check ai2kit-release --slug=ai2kit
